# single.lsa.lsa_single_trial { #fmrimod.single.lsa.lsa_single_trial }

```python
lsa_single_trial(
    Y,
    X,
    confounds=None,
    return_se=False,
    trial_labels=None,
    baseline_regressors=None,
    include_intercept=False,
)
```

Estimate trial-wise betas via standard OLS (all trials simultaneous).

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name                | Type                             | Description                                                         | Default    |
|---------------------|----------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| Y                   | NDArray, shape ``(n, V)``        | Data matrix.                                                        | _required_ |
| X                   | NDArray, shape ``(n, n_trials)`` | Trial regressor matrix.                                             | _required_ |
| confounds           | NDArray, shape ``(n, q)``        | Nuisance regressors.                                                | `None`     |
| return_se           | bool                             | If ``True``, compute standard errors.                               | `False`    |
| trial_labels        | list of str                      | Labels for each trial.                                              | `None`     |
| baseline_regressors | NDArray, shape ``(n, p)``        | Baseline or experimental regressors included in the all-trials GLM. | `None`     |
| include_intercept   | bool                             | If ``True``, add an intercept to the adjustment design.             | `False`    |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type              | Description   |
|--------|-------------------|---------------|
|        | SingleTrialResult |               |
